name: plateau-revenue-platform
description: Plateau State Digital Grassroots Revenue & Taxpayer Services Platform

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @psirs/shared && npm run build --workspace @psirs/api && npm run build --workspace @psirs/agent && npm run build --workspace @psirs/portal
scripts.build:api: npm run build --workspace @psirs/shared && npm run build --workspace @psirs/api
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @psirs/shared && npm run test --workspace @psirs/api && npm run test --workspace @psirs/agent && npm run test --workspace @psirs/portal
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run check:hausa-review && npm run test && npm run test:concurrency
scripts.test:concurrency: npm run build --workspace @psirs/shared && npm run test:concurrency --workspace @psirs/api
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/shared apps/api && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/agent/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/portal/tsconfig.json
scripts.uat: scripts/uat/stack.sh up && npx playwright test tests/browser/uat.spec.ts
